book.name: 1Tasolonqe Asaas
book.title: Phawuloosi Tasolonqe Asaas Xaafida Koyro Kiita

content: Tasolonqen Phawuloosa Ooso
Nu ishatoo! Nu inttekon gam7ida gam7oy hada gidonttayssa intteka ereeta.

Intteka erizayssa mala hayssafe kase Piliphisiyoosen nu waayenne meto be7idossinne cayettidos; gido attiin aynne mino waayey nuna gakkikokka Xoossa Mishiraachcho qaalaa inttes yootanaas nu Godaappe xalateth demmidos.
Nu inttena zorida zorey iita qofara woykko inttena baleththanaas koyidi gidenna.

Gido attiin nu Mishiraachcho qaalaa hadara ekkanaas dandayza asata mala Xoossi nuna qoodida gishshas nu haasayoos; hessaka nu ooththizay nu wozina paacci eriza Xoossaa ufayssanaas attiin as ufayssanaas giidi gidenna.
Nu mulekka baleththo qaala yootibeekko woykko nu uuzeteth kammanaas giidi baleththo hano nu hanonttayssa intte ereeta; hayssaska nu markkay Xoossa.
Inttefe gidiin woykko haratappe oonappeka asappe imettiza bonchcho nu koyibeekko.
Nu Kirstoosi kiittidayta gidida gishshas inttes tooho gidanaas dandayoos; gido attiin aaya ba nayta dichchiza mala nunikka intte giddon ashketeththan simerettidos.
Xoossa qaala xalla gidontta dishin nu shemppoka intte gishshas ufayssan immana gakkanaas inttena siiqidos; gaasoykka nu inttena daro siiqida gishshassa.
Nu ishatoo! Nu dafeteththaanne nu daaburaa intte ereeta; oonaska tooho gidontta mala qammanne gallas nuus ooththishe Mishiraachcho qaalaa inttes yootidos.
Nu inttenara ammanizaytara diza wode xilloteththaninne geeshshateththan qasseka wosoy baynda nu waani de7idaakko intteka Xoossika nuus markka.
Aaway ba naytas haniza mala nunikka inttes issaas issaas ay hanidaakko intte ereeta.
Intte inttena ba kawoteththassinne ba bonchchos xeygida Xoossaas bessiza mala intte daana mala nu inttena minththidos; lo7eththi zoridossinne hadara gidos.

Intte nuuppe siyida Xoossa qaalaa ekkida wode ammaniza intte achchan tumu ooththiza Xoossa qaalaa mala ekkideta attiin coo asa qaala mala intte ekkontta aggida gishshas nuni Xoossaa qanxxoy baynda galatoos.
Nu ishatoo! Yuhuda biittan Yesus Kirstoosa ammaniza Xoossa Woosa Keeththata misatideta; istti Ayhudatappe metonne waaye ekkida mala intteka intte asaappe waaye ekkideta.
Istti Godaa Yesusanne kase nabetakka wodhida; nunakka gooddida; Xoossaaka ufayssibeettenna; as ubbaara eqettizayta gidida.

Hessika Ayzaabeti siyidi attana qaala nu isttas yootontta mala digganaassa; hessa mala ooson ba nagara ubba wode ba bolla wurseth gakkanaas gujji gujji beettes; Xoossa hanqoyka istta bolla wodhdhides.
Phawuloosi Tasolonqe Asaa Beyanaas Laamoteth
Gidikkoka nu ishatoo! Nu guuththa wodes inttefe Ayanan gidontta ashon shaakettikokka intte laamotay nuna wodhiza gishshas intte ayfeso beyanaas daro dafeteththan doos.
Nu intteko baanaas daro laamotidos shin harappeka ta Phawuloosi daro wode dafettadis shin Xala7ey nuna diggides.
Godaa Yesusi haa yiza wode iza sinththan nu hidotay woykko nu ufayssi woykko nu zawudey nuus inttefe haray oonee?
Tumappeka nu ufayssinne nu bonchchoy inttena.
